_about: Night market words, Writer's placeholder pass (VS-31, 2026-10-09). Final text comes at VS-37; Ross approves final words (Dialogue & writing is Level 0). Same ids the Level Designer's slice/placements.json already points at, plus a few new ids for story-state variants (_taken: the main job is taken; _party: the walk home after the boss, flag market_party). Tone: loud and cheerful market (Ross F96); the Signals patrol is the only hush, and even that is a little funny. Red is silent: she only ever gestures (speaker red, gesture) or is described by the narrator. Speakers: crowd_* ids are townsfolk in the plain box; otis and mox are the two named speakers here. Scene words (hideout wake, the Mox deck handover, the Gate 4 pass, the ending walk home) are in slice_scenes.json; fight and radio lines in slice_barks.json; ambient one-liners are in slice/placements.json (barks).

mk_sq_pop.speaker: crowd_pop
mk_sq_pop.text: RED! Little bean! Sit, sit, the broth is loud tonight!

mk_sq_pop.speaker: crowd_pop
mk_sq_pop.text: I feed everyone. The block, the kids, the patrol. ...Especially the patrol. They tip in silence.

mk_sq_pop_taken.speaker: crowd_pop
mk_sq_pop_taken.text: Yard 9? Then you eat first. Rule of the cart: nobody gets scrapped on an empty bowl.

mk_sq_pop_party.speaker: crowd_pop
mk_sq_pop_party.text: RED! BOWL'S ON THE HOUSE! Pop has never said that sentence! Pop is saying it twice!

mk_sq_pop_party.speaker: crowd_pop
mk_sq_pop_party.text: Slurp as LOUD as you like. Nobody is writing it up tonight.

mk_sq_dumpling.speaker: crowd_dumpling_cook
mk_sq_dumpling.text: Sample? It is a little cold. ...Mm. Asleep. Sorry. Sample?

mk_sq_dumpling.speaker: crowd_dumpling_cook
mk_sq_dumpling.text: These are my best. I think. I was dreaming when I folded them.

mk_sq_tape.speaker: crowd_tape_keeper
mk_sq_tape.text: Scrap wire by the foot! Tape by the mood! What is yours today?

mk_sq_tape.speaker: crowd_tape_keeper
mk_sq_tape.text: Mine is 'sticky.' Yours looks like 'urgent.' That is the red tape. Fits you.

mk_sq_odds.speaker: crowd_odds_man
mk_sq_odds.text: Will the screen glitch before ten? Two rations says yes.

mk_sq_odds.speaker: crowd_odds_man
mk_sq_odds.text: I am right most days. It has ruined my social life.

mk_sq_odds_taken.speaker: crowd_odds_man
mk_sq_odds_taken.text: Yard 9, is it? I would bet on you. ...Nobody will take the other side.

mk_sq_odds_taken.speaker: crowd_odds_man
mk_sq_odds_taken.text: That is the trouble with being right. Nobody plays with me.

mk_sq_odds_party.speaker: crowd_odds_man
mk_sq_odds_party.text: I lost three rations on you and I have never been happier. Do not tell my pride.

mk_sq_neighbor.speaker: crowd_neighbor
mk_sq_neighbor.text: You were out at all hours again! I bake at three. We are not so different.

mk_sq_neighbor.speaker: crowd_neighbor
mk_sq_neighbor.text: Bring me a speaker and I will bake to it. ...Not THAT loud.

mk_sq_ume.speaker: crowd_grandma_ume
mk_sq_ume.text: Phones, five minutes a bar. Do not touch the cords.

mk_sq_ume.speaker: crowd_grandma_ume
mk_sq_ume.text: I said do not touch the cords!

mk_sq_ume.speaker: crowd_grandma_ume
mk_sq_ume.text: ...Not you, Red. You can touch them. Gently. Like a sleeping noodle.

mk_sq_ume_party.speaker: crowd_grandma_ume
mk_sq_ume_party.text: Free charging tonight! Every phone on the line! Hands OFF the cords, though.

mk_sq_shopper_a.speaker: crowd_shopper_a
mk_sq_shopper_a.text: Four for the price of three! Get in, get in!

mk_sq_shopper_a.speaker: crowd_shopper_a
mk_sq_shopper_a.text: ...Is that a good deal? I stopped checking.

mk_sq_shopper_b.speaker: crowd_shopper_b
mk_sq_shopper_b.text: The screen is looking at us again. Pretend to browse.

mk_sq_shopper_c.speaker: crowd_shopper_c
mk_sq_shopper_c.text: New headphones! Turned all the way up! Do not tell Mom.

mk_sq_shopper_c.speaker: crowd_shopper_c
mk_sq_shopper_c.text: WHAT? ...I SAID DO NOT TELL MOM!

mk_sq_shopper_d.speaker: crowd_shopper_d
mk_sq_shopper_d.text: Wind chimes are back on the poles this week. Hear that? That is the good stuff.

mk_sq_wolf_a_party.speaker: crowd_patrol_wolf_a
mk_sq_wolf_a_party.text: (a very small wave, then a cough) ...Move along. Kindly.

mk_sq_wolf_b.speaker: crowd_patrol_wolf_b
mk_sq_wolf_b.text: Eyes front. Boots quiet. ...Whose dumplings are those?

mk_sq_wolf_b_party.speaker: crowd_patrol_wolf_b
mk_sq_wolf_b_party.text: ...Nice walker. Do not tell anyone I said so.

mk_wf_juno.speaker: crowd_juno
mk_wf_juno.text: Watch the track! Tuesday-class drones only. ...Mine crashes. Always the green one.

mk_wf_juno.speaker: crowd_juno
mk_wf_juno.text: It is not the drone. It is the pilot. ...It is the drone.

mk_wf_kid_a.speaker: crowd_drone_kid_a
mk_wf_kid_a.text: Do not tell the patrol it is a race. It is a... delivery rehearsal.

mk_wf_kid_b.speaker: crowd_drone_kid_b
mk_wf_kid_b.text: Go go go! It is turning! It is... not turning!

mk_wf_judge.speaker: crowd_race_judge
mk_wf_judge.text: (through the megaphone) FIRST PLACE: BLUE. SECOND PLACE: RED. THIRD PLACE: A SEAGULL, SOMEHOW.

mk_wf_judge.speaker: crowd_race_judge
mk_wf_judge.text: (through the megaphone) THE GREEN ONE HAS CRASHED. AGAIN. WE LOVE IT.

mk_wf_pell.speaker: crowd_pell
mk_wf_pell.text: Hello, courier! Papers are my hobby. Ask me about papers, I dare you.

mk_wf_pell.speaker: crowd_pell
mk_wf_pell.text: No? Everybody says no. ...I will be here. With the papers.

mk_wf_pell_form.speaker: crowd_pell
mk_wf_pell_form.text: An Appeal Form! Signals hands out the tickets and never mentions the forms. You have to know somebody.

mk_wf_pell_form.speaker: crowd_pell
mk_wf_pell_form.text: Drop it in the APPEALS slot at Gate 4. In triplicate. Well, once. It is a start.

mk_wf_pell_go.speaker: crowd_pell
mk_wf_pell_go.text: Booth slot, Gate 4. Do not fold it. They hate it when you fold it.

mk_wf_pell_done.speaker: crowd_pell
mk_wf_pell_done.text: Filed. They said my appeal is important to them. ...Nobody has said that to me in years.

mk_wf_late_cook.speaker: crowd_late_cook
mk_wf_late_cook.text: Pop's cousin. Same menu. Better view.

mk_wf_late_cook.speaker: crowd_late_cook
mk_wf_late_cook.text: Worse broth. Do not tell Pop.

mk_wf_fisher.speaker: crowd_fisher
mk_wf_fisher.text: It was my own boot. But a bite is a bite.

mk_gt_grunt_a.speaker: crowd_gate_grunt_a
mk_gt_grunt_a.text: No papers, no boom. That is the whole job. I like it. It is simple.

mk_gt_grunt_a_open.speaker: crowd_gate_grunt_a
mk_gt_grunt_a_open.text: Pass is in order. Stamp, stamp. Boom's up.

mk_gt_grunt_a_open.speaker: crowd_gate_grunt_a
mk_gt_grunt_a_open.text: Keep it down on the road. The Sergeant is in a mood.

mk_gt_grunt_b.speaker: crowd_gate_grunt_b
mk_gt_grunt_b.text: Noise ticket. One wind chime. Form 12.

mk_gt_grunt_b.speaker: crowd_gate_grunt_b
mk_gt_grunt_b.text: I did not write the rules. I write the tickets.

mk_gt_line_a.speaker: crowd_line_a
mk_gt_line_a.text: It's only a wind chime. One little wind chime.

mk_gt_line_a.speaker: crowd_line_a
mk_gt_line_a.text: My nan made it. It sounds like her laughing. They will melt it down for a whistle.

mk_gt_line_b.speaker: crowd_line_b
mk_gt_line_b.text: I know every crack in this floor. That one is Gerald.

mk_gt_line_c.speaker: crowd_line_c
mk_gt_line_c.text: Do not make eye contact with the searchlight.

mk_gt_line_c.speaker: crowd_line_c
mk_gt_line_c.text: It can tell. It is very sensitive.

mk_dp_sleeper.speaker: crowd_sleeping_courier
mk_dp_sleeper.text: ...five more minutes... the parcel can wait...

mk_dp_dispatcher.speaker: crowd_dispatcher
mk_dp_dispatcher.text: Job board is on the wall, Red. The big one is Yard 9: the Signals scrapyard behind the ore line.

mk_dp_dispatcher.speaker: crowd_dispatcher
mk_dp_dispatcher.text: Everything they confiscate ends up there. Radios. Bells. Chimes. ...Not that I am saying anything. I dispatch. That is all.

mk_dp_dispatcher.speaker: crowd_dispatcher
mk_dp_dispatcher.text: Take it or do not. The deadline is already angry.

mk_dp_dispatcher_taken.speaker: crowd_dispatcher
mk_dp_dispatcher_taken.text: Yard 9. Pass is stamped. Gate 4, then the road. Keep it down out there.

mk_dp_dispatcher_taken.speaker: crowd_dispatcher
mk_dp_dispatcher_taken.text: And bring everyone back. ...Including you. Especially you. Red? Red?

mk_dp_dispatcher_taken.speaker: narrator
mk_dp_dispatcher_taken.text: Red already has her goggles down. She left a sentence ago.

mk_dp_dispatcher_done.speaker: crowd_dispatcher
mk_dp_dispatcher_done.text: Stamped DONE. ...Everyone is talking about it. Loudly.

mk_dp_dispatcher_done.speaker: crowd_dispatcher
mk_dp_dispatcher_done.text: Nobody has ever been this loud in my office. I have allowed it. Once.

mk_dp_board.speaker: narrator
mk_dp_board.text: The job board. Curling slips, ring-stained, some stamped twice. One has a tiny drawing of a sword in the margin.

mk_cs_keeper.speaker: crowd_shopkeeper
mk_cs_keeper.text: Everything you need, nothing you want. The usual?

mk_cs_keeper.speaker: crowd_shopkeeper
mk_cs_keeper.text: Two canned coffees and the face of someone who needs three. Counter's yours.

mk_cs_clerk.speaker: crowd_clerk
mk_cs_clerk.text: Antacids. Do not look at the badge. I am just a guy.

mk_cs_clerk.speaker: crowd_clerk
mk_cs_clerk.text: Quota is eleven tickets a day. I have written ten. All to the same bench. It never argues.

mk_fg_otis.speaker: otis
mk_fg_otis.text: Swords are on the wall. Ask, and I will tinker.

mk_fg_otis.speaker: otis
mk_fg_otis.text: That blade of yours has seen things. ...You look happier than it does.

mk_fg_otis_taken.speaker: otis
mk_fg_otis_taken.text: Yard 9? I used to haul from there. Mind the cranes, friend. They do not mean it, but they swing.

mk_fg_otis_taken.speaker: otis
mk_fg_otis_taken.text: {face:worried}Come back by dark. I count heads, you know. I will leave a space.

mk_fg_otis_party.speaker: otis
mk_fg_otis_party.text: {face:laughing}I heard that walker from here, friend. Whole forge rang.

mk_fg_otis_party.speaker: otis
mk_fg_otis_party.text: {face:calm}Let me count you. One. Good. One is perfect.

mk_rp_mox.speaker: mox
mk_rp_mox.text: {face:boasting}Red! The deck is a hundred percent... {face:sheepish}forty percent finished. Tuesday, say hi. ...Tuesday?

mk_rp_mox.speaker: mox
mk_rp_mox.text: She is up there somewhere. She is very shy. ...She is the ceiling fan. No. No, that is the ceiling fan.

mk_rp_mox_party.speaker: mox
mk_rp_mox_party.text: {face:proud}RED! I watched it from the roof! The big robot! That was FORTY PERCENT MY IDEA!

mk_rp_mox_party.speaker: mox
mk_rp_mox_party.text: Okay, ten. Ten percent. ...Fifteen, if you count the tape.

mk_ar_owner.speaker: crowd_arcade_owner
mk_ar_owner.text: Turn it up! Every machine has a different beep. Do not touch the claw. The claw knows.

mk_ar_owner.speaker: crowd_arcade_owner
mk_ar_owner.text: A credit is a coin. Fun is free. ...Fun is also a coin. I lied.

mk_ar_kid_a.speaker: crowd_arcade_kid_a
mk_ar_kid_a.text: Beep. Beep beep. Beeeep. (That was a win.)

mk_ar_kid_b.speaker: crowd_arcade_kid_b
mk_ar_kid_b.text: Zed is one point behind the champ. One! I have been watching all week.

mk_ar_kid_b.speaker: crowd_arcade_kid_b
mk_ar_kid_b.text: I will help him. By sitting very close.

mk_ar_kid_c.speaker: crowd_arcade_kid_c
mk_ar_kid_c.text: Beep beep BEEP! I am on the last level!

mk_ar_kid_c.speaker: crowd_arcade_kid_c
mk_ar_kid_c.text: It loops. The last level loops.

mk_ar_zed.speaker: crowd_zed
mk_ar_zed.text: Nine thousand nine hundred eighty-nine. ...You are at nine nine nine zero? One point. Always one point.

mk_ar_zed.speaker: crowd_zed
mk_ar_zed.text: I could beat you. I am just working up to it.

mk_ar_scores.speaker: sign
mk_ar_scores.text: HIGH SCORES: RED 9990. ZED 9989. A third line has been scratched out.

mk_sq_screen.speaker: sign
mk_sq_screen.text: THE ADMIRAL SPEAKS: A QUIET MOON IS A SAFE MOON.

mk_sq_screen.speaker: sign
mk_sq_screen.text: MEMO (scrolling): QUIET HOURS ARE EVERY HOUR. THIS INCLUDES LUNCH. - SGT. KASP

mk_sq_screen.speaker: narrator
mk_sq_screen.text: Three kids by the pole do the Admiral's salute. Slightly wrong. On purpose.

mk_sq_screen_party.speaker: narrator
mk_sq_screen_party.text: The screen is dark. Someone has taped a drawing over it: two long ears and a sword far too big. Underneath, in crayon: THANKS.

mk_sq_phone_rack.speaker: narrator
mk_sq_phone_rack.text: A washing line of phones, all charging off Grandma Ume's window. Cords swing like vines. Every phone has a name on tape.

mk_sq_phone_rack.speaker: narrator
mk_sq_phone_rack.text: One is labelled DEFINITELY NOT MOX'S. It is ringing.

mk_sq_window_ledge.speaker: narrator
mk_sq_window_ledge.text: Ume's window. A ledge under it, two crates to climb. The sill is warm.

mk_sq_window_ledge_done.speaker: narrator
mk_sq_window_ledge_done.text: The phones are all charged. Somebody inside is humming along.

mk_sq_tarp_pole.speaker: narrator
mk_sq_tarp_pole.text: The pole holds the tarps and a tangle of string lights. Somebody taped a tiny flag to it. The flag says PLEASE. Nobody knows what for.

mk_sq_bets_board.speaker: sign
mk_sq_bets_board.text: BETS: Will the screen glitch before ten? / Will Pop run out of broth? / Will the patrol smile? (odds: never)

mk_sq_bets_board.speaker: sign
mk_sq_bets_board.text: NEW: Will the courier come back from Yard 9? (odds: nobody will say)

mk_sq_bets_party.speaker: sign
mk_sq_bets_party.text: BETS: PAID OUT, in angry capitals. Below, smaller: Will the patrol wave? ...They did. Pay up, Gerald.

mk_sq_memo_board.speaker: sign
mk_sq_memo_board.text: MEMO. Noise is a choice. Choose less. - K.

mk_sq_memo_board.speaker: sign
mk_sq_memo_board.text: MEMO. Productivity at the docks is down 4%. Coughing is up 11%. I have drawn my own conclusions. - K.

mk_sq_memo_board.speaker: sign
mk_sq_memo_board.text: MEMO. A wind chime is a bell, and a bell is a receiver in a hat. All three are confiscated. - K.

mk_sq_memo_party.speaker: narrator
mk_sq_memo_party.text: Kasp's memo board is empty. One pin is left. Somebody has pinned a noodle coupon to it.

mk_wf_screen.speaker: narrator
mk_wf_screen.text: The Admiral's face with a sticker moustache. Somebody added eyebrows. Somebody else added a monocle.

mk_wf_tide_board.speaker: sign
mk_wf_tide_board.text: TIDE: in. Then out. Then in. Then, we think, out.

mk_wf_crane.speaker: narrator
mk_wf_crane.text: A crane, standing very still. Somebody hung a laundry line off the arm. The laundry is waving.

mk_wf_results.speaker: sign
mk_wf_results.text: RACE RESULTS: 1st Tuesday-class (blue). 2nd Tuesday-class (red). Green: crashed, again. Green: forgiven.

mk_gt_appeals_slot.speaker: narrator
mk_gt_appeals_slot.text: APPEALS. A slot in the booth. A recorded voice: 'Your appeal is important to us.' There is nothing to drop in it yet.

mk_gt_appeals_done.speaker: narrator
mk_gt_appeals_done.text: The slot hums. A recorded voice: 'Your appeal is important to us.' It almost sounds sincere.

mk_gt_poster.speaker: sign
mk_gt_poster.text: MEMO. Yard 9 is closed to the public. This includes couriers. This includes ones with passes. The pass is a formality. - K.

mk_gt_poster.speaker: narrator
mk_gt_poster.text: Someone chalked a moustache on Kasp's face. Someone else added a second, to be safe.

mk_gt_poster_party.speaker: sign
mk_gt_poster_party.text: QUIET HOURS SAVE LIVES (CLOSED FOR REPAIRS).

mk_gt_poster_party.speaker: narrator
mk_gt_poster_party.text: The poster has been taken down. The moustache is still there. On the wall. In chalk. It looks lonely.

mk_hd_stickers.speaker: narrator
mk_hd_stickers.text: One sticker per delivery. The wall is nearly full. The newest one is a very small sword.

mk_hd_photo.speaker: narrator
mk_hd_photo.text: Mom, young, grinning, in a flight jacket. Written on the back: 'Fly loud.'

mk_hd_charts.speaker: narrator
mk_hd_charts.text: Mom's old flight charts. The lines go somewhere you can no longer fly.

mk_hd_parcel.speaker: narrator
mk_hd_parcel.text: A parcel marked 'MOX WUZ HERE'. Heavy. Ticks faintly. You leave it.

mk_rp_scratch.speaker: narrator
mk_rp_scratch.text: Scratched into the counter: MOX WUZ HERE. Underneath, smaller: 'and Tuesday.'

mk_fg_bridge_lamp.speaker: narrator
mk_fg_bridge_lamp.text: A rusty ship's bridge light, bolted to the end of the counter. Otis polishes it when he thinks nobody is looking.

mk_fg_bridge_lamp.speaker: otis
mk_fg_bridge_lamp.text: Came off a hull I hauled for the Navy. ...Somebody had left it on.

mk_charge_drop.speaker: narrator
mk_charge_drop.text: You set the battery brick on the sill. A phone on the line blinks awake. A hand snatches the brick inside.

mk_charge_reward.speaker: crowd_grandma_ume
mk_charge_reward.text: Do not touch the cords! ...Thank you, Red. There is something on the sill. Take it before I change my mind.

mk_appeal_drop.speaker: narrator
mk_appeal_drop.text: You slide the form into the APPEALS slot. It is eaten. A recorded voice: 'Your appeal is important to us.'

mk_appeal_paid.speaker: narrator
mk_appeal_paid.text: A note slides out of the slot: 'FILED. PAYMENT ATTACHED. - P.' Two rations and some credits follow, a little damp.
